source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

items.name: Site Bound
items.text: These three ghosts can only leave the crypts when Bastardhall appears on Golarion, and even then, they can't leave the island.

items.name: Rejuvenation
items.text: The three adventurers re-form after 2d4 days here in the crypts unless someone carries their respective urn of ashes down to the temple in Maiserene (area A9) to be cleansed by Shirail.

items.name: Amondi's Cruel Shiv
items.text: Amondi Flies once, moving through a target creature's space; this movement doesn't trigger reactions. As she moves through the target's space, she makes a ghostly weapon Strike against the target. If she hits, she deals an additional 3d6 persistent bleed damage, and the creature struck becomes Sickened 1 from the pain of the bloody wound.

items.name: Malevolent Possession
items.text: The ghost attempts to possess an adjacent corporeal creature. This has the same effect as the Possession spell (DC 23 Will save), except since the ghost doesn't have a physical body, it is unaffected by that restriction of the spell.
